---
title: "`r paste('Monitoring report —', params$mpa)`"
author: "MPA monitoring team"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
params:
  mpa: "Ankaramena"
  year: 2025
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4)
library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(here)
reef  <- read.csv(here("data", "raw", "reef_monitoring.csv"))
sites <- read.csv(here("data", "raw", "reef_sites.csv"))
reef  <- left_join(reef, sites, by = "site_id")

# keep ONLY the MPA asked for in params
mine <- filter(reef, mpa == params$mpa)
now  <- filter(mine, year == params$year)
before <- filter(mine, year == params$year - 1)
m_now <- round(mean(now$hard_coral), 1)
m_before <- round(mean(before$hard_coral), 1)
```

# `r params$mpa` in `r params$year`

The team surveyed **`r length(unique(now$site_id))` sites** and **`r nrow(now)` transects**.
Mean hard coral cover was **`r m_now` %**
(`r if (nrow(before) > 0) paste0(m_before, " % in ", params$year - 1) else "no survey the year before"`).

```{r fig, fig.cap = paste("Hard coral cover per site in", params$mpa, ",", params$year)}
ggplot(now, aes(reorder(site_id, hard_coral), hard_coral, fill = zone)) +
  geom_boxplot() + coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No-take" = "#1b7f8c", "Fishing" = "#d9694a")) +
  labs(x = "Site", y = "Hard coral cover (%)", fill = NULL) + theme_minimal()
```

```{r table}
now %>% group_by(zone) %>%
  summarise(transects = n(), mean = round(mean(hard_coral), 1), bleached = round(mean(bleached_pct), 1)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Mean cover and bleaching per zone (%)")
```
